name: KPI dashboard
description: Big, glanceable metric tiles with progress to target and a coloured change indicator. Feed it a Google Sheet, CSV, REST API or manual table (columns Metric, Value, Target, Unit, Change), or type the metrics in. Fits 1 to 12 tiles in any screen shape.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: data
params.label: Metrics data source (optional)
params.help: A table-shaped source (Google Sheets, CSV, REST API or Manual table) with columns Metric, Value and optionally Target, Unit, Change. Leave empty to use the metrics typed below.

params.name: metrics
params.label: Metrics (used without a data source)
params.help: One per line: Metric | Value | Target | Unit | Change. Only Metric and Value are required.
params.default:
Revenue this month | 184250 | 200000 | $ | +6.4%
New customers | 312 | 300 | | +18
Net promoter score | 64 | 60 | | +3
Support tickets open | 27 | | | -9
Avg. response time | 1.8 | 2 | h | -0.4
Uptime | 99.97 | 99.9 | % | +0.02

params.name: max_tiles
params.label: Show at most
params.help: Rows beyond this number are not shown.

params.name: up_is_good
params.label: An increase is good
params.help: Colours a positive change as good. A metric whose name contains open, response time, churn, cost, error or wait is treated the other way round.

params.name: locale
params.label: Number and date language
params.help: For example en-US or de-DE. Leave empty for the screen's language.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone for “Updated”
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.
